explication: Nextcloud News is an RSS/Atom aggregator with a Vue client and a Nextcloud-hosted PHP API. The main user flow is browsing feeds and folders, requesting item lists, and changing read or starred state; controllers delegate those operations to services and database mappers. Separately, scheduled jobs fetch and parse subscriptions into items. The README also identifies a REST API; the tree documents import/export, sharing, search, recommendations, and podcast playback. Links for unsampled subsystems are limited to directory-level evidence.
